def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # The all-zero row separates two aligned patterns; mark their overlap.
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if all(x == 0 for x in row):
            upper, lower = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            n = min(len(upper), len(lower))
            return [
                [3 if upper[i][j] == 5 and lower[i][j] == 7 else 7
                 for j in range(w)]
                for i in range(n)
            ]

    # Otherwise the all-6 column separates the two patterns.
    for c in range(w):
        if all(grid[i][c] == 6 for i in range(h)):
            return [
                [3 if grid[i][j] == 9 and grid[i][c + 1 + j] == 9 else 9
                 for j in range(c)]
                for i in range(h)
            ]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(c for c in range(w)
               if len(set(grid[r][c] for r in range(h))) == 1)
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:sep + 1 + sep] for row in grid]

    # The right panel's common color is the output background. Mark
    # positions where the left foreground overlaps that same color.
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(x for row in right for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    fg = Counter(x for row in left for x in row if x != 0).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == fg and right[r][c] == bg else bg
             for c in range(sep)] for r in range(h)]

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The divider is the uniform column separating equal-sized panels.
    dividers = [c for c in range(w)
                if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    sep = min(dividers, key=lambda c: abs(c - (w - 1) / 2))
    n = min(sep, w - sep - 1)

    left = [row[:n] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:sep + 1 + n] for row in grid]
    left_bg = Counter(x for row in left for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    right_bg = Counter(x for row in right for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    return [[3 if left[r][c] != left_bg else right_bg
             for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Choose the uniform separator nearest the center.
    candidates = [c for c in range(w)
                  if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    sep = min(candidates, key=lambda c: abs(c - (w - 1) / 2))

    n = min(sep, w - sep - 1)
    left = [row[:n] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:sep + 1 + n] for row in grid]

    background = Counter(x for row in right for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    left_counts = Counter(x for row in left for x in row)
    foreground = min(left_counts, key=left_counts.get)

    return [[3 if x == foreground else background for x in row] for row in left]
